Advanced Chiropractic and Rehabilitation Centers. 

At Premier Chiropractic, we present a subtle and safe approach to alleviating pain by manipulating and correcting the misalignment of the musculoskeletal system, particularly in the spine or joints that may be out of alignment due to chronic degeneration or injury. 

Some of the issues that respond well to chiropractic treatments include:

Back Pain
Neck Pain
Disc Injuries
Hip Pain
Sciatica
Shoulder Pain
Arthritis
Migraines/Headaches
Whiplash

Regular chiropractic care includes other benefits in addition to pain relief, such as enhanced joint mobility, improved range of motion, better sleep, increased work productivity, and an overall better standard of living.

Locations:

West Pearland:
11470 Broadway St #110, Pearland, TX 77584
(281) 741-1409

East Pearland:
2018 E Broadway St, Pearland, TX 77581
(281) 485-2955
